property_summary: For all inputs, the reference contract C.returnd true from transfer iff the call does not revert; specifically C always reverts when _tos.length==0 (requires non-empty), but the mutant allows empty _tos and thus can return true for that input—so the rule: transfer(...) always reverts when _tos is empty; the mutant breaks this by accepting empty _tos and returning true.
change_summary: Change the required condition to allow zero-length _tos (removes the require check), so transfer can proceed when _tos.length == 0 and returns true (behavior differs for that input).
